title: Baby Toddler Juice, Fruit and Vegetable

content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Juice is a 100 % natural drink made from selected fruits and vegetables, specially formulated for children aged 6 months to 3 years. It contains no added sugar, preservatives, or artificial flavors. The juice supports the development of taste preferences and provides essential vitamins and minerals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is produced by cold‑press extraction, preserving most of the nutrients.
It combines apple, carrot, pear and spinach – a blend rich in beta‑carotene and vitamin C.
Each package features a QR code that reveals the origin of the ingredients when scanned.
The product has passed independent testing for pesticide residues and heavy metals.
Its mild sweetness and smooth texture make the transition from breast milk to solid foods easier.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and enhances iron absorption from plant foods.

items.title: Contains beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene is converted to vitamin A, which is important for vision and cell growth.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports heart function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Dietary fiber from the fruits and vegetables promotes healthy bowel movements.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: The juice contains no added sugars, helping to establish healthy eating habits early.

items.title: Allergy to fruit components
items.content: Children with known allergies to apple, pear, or carrot should be evaluated by a pediatrician before introducing the product.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 6 months
items.content: Babies younger than 6 months should receive only breast milk or specialized infant formula.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Once opened, the juice should be consumed within 24 hours and kept refrigerated to prevent microbial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the juice in small portions (30–60 ml) from a clean bottle or cup. Gently shake before serving to evenly distribute any sediment. It can be mixed with a small amount of baby puree for flavor variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened packages in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the juice refrigerated and use within one day. Discard if the smell, color, or taste changes.
